spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th (3d10), and 17th (4d10).

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th (4d8).

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th (4d8).

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.
spells.higher_levels: Additional beams at 5th level (2), 11th (3), and 17th (4).

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target.
spells.higher_levels: One additional dart for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.higher_levels: Healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.higher_levels: Healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled.
spells.higher_levels: One additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.material: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket
spells.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect.
spells.higher_levels: Add 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.
spells.higher_levels: One additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.material: a small, straight piece of iron
spells.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.
spells.higher_levels: One additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.material: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.material: a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass
spells.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability.
spells.higher_levels: Automatically counters spells of the slot level used or lower.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability.
spells.higher_levels: Automatically ends spells of the slot level used or lower.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.material: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes
spells.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.material: a small crystal or glass cone
spells.description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.higher_levels: Healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.material: a small, straight piece of iron
spells.description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.
spells.higher_levels: One additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.material: a lodestone and a pinch of dust
spells.description: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range. The target can be a creature, an object, or a creation of magical force. A creature targeted by this spell must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d6 + 40 force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated.
spells.higher_levels: Damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target.
spells.higher_levels: Healing increases by 10 for each slot level above 6th.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

spells.name: Power Word Stun
spells.description: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires.
